seo.title: Convert MP4 to WAV Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert MP4 to WAV in your browser: the soundtrack is saved as uncompressed 16-bit WAV audio and the video is dropped. Free, with no sign-up.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert MP4 to WAV

tool.subtitle: Save the sound from an MP4 video as a WAV file, right in your browser.

faqs.question: How do I convert an MP4 to WAV?
faqs.answer: Choose the MP4 above and start the conversion. FFmpeg takes the audio, writes it as 16-bit PCM in a WAV file and drops the video. Then download the WAV.

faqs.question: Why is the WAV so much bigger than the MP4?
faqs.answer: WAV stores the audio as uncompressed PCM, while an MP4 usually holds compressed audio. The video is gone, but the WAV can still be the larger file.

faqs.question: Will the WAV sound better than the MP4's audio?
faqs.answer: No. WAV is lossless, so it keeps what the video's audio has, but it can't restore detail that compression already removed from the MP4.

faqs.question: What if my MP4 has no sound?
faqs.answer: FFmpeg stops with an error, since a WAV needs audio and there is none in the file. A silent clip can't be turned into a WAV.

faqs.question: What if my MP4 has several audio tracks?
faqs.answer: The page doesn't choose a track itself, so FFmpeg's defaults decide which one you get. Check the WAV after converting if the video has more than one.

fromFormat.name: MP4
fromFormat.description: A container format defined in ISO/IEC 14496-14 that can hold video, audio, subtitles and metadata. H.264 video with AAC audio is the most common combination.

toFormat.name: WAV
toFormat.description: An audio container format developed by Microsoft and IBM that is based on RIFF. It usually holds uncompressed PCM audio, so files are large but exact.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting MP4 to WAV
points: Only the sound is kept: the video is dropped.
The audio is written as uncompressed 16-bit PCM.
WAV files are large, and a WAV has a 4 GB file size limit.
An MP4 without an audio track can't be converted.
Converting several MP4 files gives one WAV for each, with no ZIP.

seo.title: Convert JFIF to PDF Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert JFIF to PDF in your browser, with no upload. Each JFIF becomes its own one-page PDF the size of the image. Free, with no sign-up.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert JFIF to PDF

tool.subtitle: Turn a JFIF image into a PDF file, right in your browser.

faqs.question: How do I convert a JFIF to PDF?
faqs.answer: Pick your .jfif file in the converter, and it becomes a PDF holding that image. The PDF is built from the decoded pixels on your device.

faqs.question: Can I combine several JFIF files into one PDF?
faqs.answer: No. You can choose several files at once, but they are converted one after another and each gives its own PDF. There is no ZIP and no merged document.

faqs.question: What page size does the JFIF PDF have?
faqs.answer: One page, as big as the picture: each pixel of the JFIF becomes 1 point. The page has no margin and isn't A4 or Letter.

faqs.question: Is the image recompressed inside the PDF?
faqs.answer: No JPEG quality setting applies. The picture is embedded losslessly as a PNG made from the decoded pixels, so the PDF doesn't add a new round of JPEG loss.

faqs.question: Does the PDF keep the JFIF's metadata?
faqs.answer: No. The image goes through raw pixels on the way to the PDF, so EXIF, ICC profiles and XMP are not carried over.

faqs.question: Why does my browser say it can't open the file?
faqs.answer: The page uses your browser's own image decoder. If it can't read the file you get an "Image decode failed." error. Try a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

fromFormat.name: JFIF
fromFormat.description: A container convention for JPEG-compressed images that specifies colour space and pixel aspect ratio. Files ending in .jfif contain ordinary JPEG image data.

toFormat.name: PDF
toFormat.description: A document format created by Adobe in 1993 and standardized as ISO 32000. It keeps text, fonts, images and layout the same on any device.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting JFIF to PDF
points: Each JFIF file gives its own PDF with one page the size of the image; files are not merged.
The page has no margin and isn't A4 or Letter.
The picture is embedded losslessly as a PNG.
EXIF, ICC profile and XMP data are dropped.
Your browser decodes the image, so the file isn't uploaded.

seo.title: Convert M4A to WAV Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert M4A to WAV in your browser: the audio is decoded and saved as uncompressed 16-bit WAV. Free, with no sign-up, and no upload.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert M4A to WAV

tool.subtitle: Decode an M4A audio file to an uncompressed WAV, right in your browser.

faqs.question: How do I convert M4A to WAV?
faqs.answer: Choose the M4A above and start the conversion. FFmpeg decodes the audio and writes it as 16-bit PCM in a WAV file, ready to download.

faqs.question: Can you convert M4A to WAV without losing quality?
faqs.answer: WAV adds no further loss. But an M4A usually holds AAC, which is lossy, so the WAV can't bring back detail AAC already removed. Apple Lossless M4A has none to lose.

faqs.question: Why is my WAV much larger than the M4A?
faqs.answer: The M4A holds compressed audio. The WAV stores it as uncompressed PCM, so it takes more space, and a WAV has a 4 GB file size limit.

faqs.question: Will cover art and tags carry over to the WAV?
faqs.answer: The page can't promise it. It passes no option for tags, so FFmpeg's defaults decide what the WAV keeps. Add tags again in your audio editor if you need them.

faqs.question: Why does an M4P file fail?
faqs.answer: An M4P is protected with FairPlay. The page refuses it with its own message and doesn't convert it. Only unprotected M4A files work.

fromFormat.name: M4A
fromFormat.description: An audio-only file in the MPEG-4 container (MP4). It usually holds AAC audio, or lossless Apple Lossless (ALAC) audio.

toFormat.name: WAV
toFormat.description: An audio container format developed by Microsoft and IBM that is based on RIFF. It usually holds uncompressed PCM audio, so files are large but exact.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting M4A to WAV
points: The WAV is uncompressed 16-bit PCM, so it is larger than the M4A.
AAC audio in an M4A is lossy: the WAV keeps it as is and can't improve it.
A FairPlay-protected M4P is refused.
Converting several M4A files gives one WAV for each, with no ZIP.

seo.title: Convert TIFF to PDF Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert TIFF to PDF in your browser with ImageMagick. A multi-page TIFF gives a single picture, not one page each. Free, with no sign-up.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert TIFF to PDF

tool.subtitle: Turn a TIFF image into a PDF file, right in your browser.

faqs.question: How do I convert a TIFF to PDF?
faqs.answer: Choose the TIFF above and start the conversion. ImageMagick runs in your browser, reads the image and writes a PDF for you to download.

faqs.question: Does a multi-page TIFF become a multi-page PDF?
faqs.answer: No. The converter reads one image from the file, so a multi-page TIFF gives one picture, not a PDF page for each. The page can't say which TIFF page it keeps.

faqs.question: Is the TIFF's PDF page A4 or Letter?
faqs.answer: Neither. The PDF has a single page cut to the picture's size, at 1 pixel to 1 point, with no margin.

faqs.question: Is the TIFF recompressed inside the PDF?
faqs.answer: ImageMagick writes the picture as a PNG, and that PNG is embedded in the PDF losslessly. No quality setting applies, and transparent pixels stay transparent.

faqs.question: Can I change several TIFF files to PDF at once?
faqs.answer: You can choose several files. They are converted one after another and each downloads as its own PDF, with no ZIP and no merging.

faqs.question: Why does a very large TIFF fail?
faqs.answer: A picture over about 537 megapixels fails with a "too large to convert here" message.

fromFormat.name: TIFF
fromFormat.description: A flexible raster image format first published by Aldus in 1986 and now maintained by Adobe. It stores one or more images with a tag-based structure and many compression options.

toFormat.name: PDF
toFormat.description: A document format created by Adobe in 1993 and standardized as ISO 32000. It keeps text, fonts, images and layout the same on any device.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting TIFF to PDF
points: Only one image is read: a multi-page TIFF gives one picture, on one PDF page.
The PDF page is the size of the image, with no margin and no A4 or Letter page.
Each TIFF file gives its own PDF; files are not merged.
A picture over about 537 megapixels can't be converted.
ImageMagick runs in your browser, so the TIFF isn't uploaded.

seo.title: Convert JFIF to PNG Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert JFIF to PNG in your browser, with no upload. The image is saved as lossless PNG pixels. Free, with no sign-up and nothing to install.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert JFIF to PNG

tool.subtitle: Save a JFIF image as a lossless PNG, right in your browser.

faqs.question: How do I convert a JFIF to PNG?
faqs.answer: Add your .jfif file and run it. A PNG is written from the image's pixels, and you save it as a new copy. The JFIF stays as it was.

faqs.question: Will the PNG look better than the JFIF?
faqs.answer: No. PNG is lossless, so it adds no new loss. But a JFIF holds JPEG data, and detail that JPEG compression removed can't be brought back.

faqs.question: Does the PNG get a transparent background?
faqs.answer: No. A JFIF has no alpha transparency, so the PNG has none to keep. PNG supports transparency, but this conversion doesn't add any.

faqs.question: Is there a quality setting?
faqs.answer: No. PNG has no quality setting and the page passes none. The pixels are written losslessly.

faqs.question: Are EXIF details kept in the PNG?
faqs.answer: No. The image goes through raw pixels, so EXIF, ICC profiles and XMP are not carried over to the PNG.

fromFormat.name: JFIF
fromFormat.description: A container convention for JPEG-compressed images that specifies colour space and pixel aspect ratio. Files ending in .jfif contain ordinary JPEG image data.

toFormat.name: PNG
toFormat.description: A lossless raster image format developed in the mid-1990s as a patent-free replacement for GIF and standardized as ISO/IEC 15948 and a W3C Recommendation.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting JFIF to PNG
points: PNG is lossless, but it can't restore detail the JPEG data already lost.
A JFIF has no transparency, so the PNG has none either.
EXIF, ICC profile and XMP data are dropped.
Converting several JFIF files gives one PNG for each, with no ZIP.

seo.howToHeading: How to convert MPEG to MP3

tool.subtitle: Save the sound from an MPEG video as a 192 kbps MP3, right in your browser.

faqs.question: How do I convert an MPEG to MP3?
faqs.answer: Choose the MPEG above and start the conversion. FFmpeg takes the audio and re-encodes it as an MP3, dropping the video. Then download the MP3.

faqs.question: What bitrate is the MP3?
faqs.answer: 192 kbps, written with the LAME encoder, whatever bitrate the MPEG's audio had.

faqs.question: Does the MP3 keep the full quality of the MPEG?
faqs.answer: No. MP3 is lossy and the audio is re-encoded, so the MP3 is at best as good as the MPEG's own sound.

faqs.question: What if the MPEG has no sound?
faqs.answer: A video with no audio track gives an FFmpeg error, and no MP3 is made. MP3 holds only sound, so a silent MPEG has nothing to save.

fromFormat.name: MPEG
fromFormat.description: A file extension for MPEG-1 or MPEG-2 video and audio in an MPEG program stream. It was the standard for VCD and DVD video, and is also seen in older video downloads and broadcast capture.
details: Opens in VLC, Windows Media Player and QuickTime Player

toFormat.name: MP3
toFormat.description: A lossy audio format standardized by MPEG (ISO/IEC 11172-3), developed with major contributions from the Fraunhofer Society. It became the most common format for downloadable music.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting MPEG to MP3
points: Only the sound is kept: the video is dropped.
The MP3 is encoded at 192 kbps.
An MPEG without an audio track can't be converted.
Converting several MPEG files gives one MP3 for each, with no ZIP.

seo.title: Convert AVI to MP4 Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert AVI to MP4 in your browser: the video is re-encoded as H.264 with AAC audio, capped at 1920 px and 30 fps. Free, with no sign-up.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert AVI to MP4

tool.subtitle: Re-encode an AVI video as an H.264 MP4, right in your browser.

faqs.question: How do I convert AVI to MP4?
faqs.answer: Choose the AVI above and start the conversion. FFmpeg re-encodes it as an MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio, then you download the MP4.

faqs.question: Can you convert AVI to MP4 without re-encoding?
faqs.answer: Not here. The video is re-encoded as H.264 and the audio as AAC. Re-encoding is lossy, so quality can drop.

faqs.question: Will the MP4 keep my video's size and frame rate?
faqs.answer: Up to a limit. The size stays unless the longer side is over 1920 px, when it is scaled down, and the frame rate is capped at 30 fps. Smaller videos keep their size and frame rate.

faqs.question: What happens to interlaced AVI video?
faqs.answer: A deinterlacing filter is applied, so interlaced frames are converted into whole frames in the MP4.

faqs.question: Why is the MP4 audio different from the AVI's?
faqs.answer: The audio is re-encoded as AAC at 96 kbps, whatever the AVI used, so it can sound different from the original.

fromFormat.name: AVI
fromFormat.description: A container format introduced by Microsoft in 1992 based on RIFF. It interleaves video and audio data and can hold many different codecs.

toFormat.name: MP4
toFormat.description: A container format defined in ISO/IEC 14496-14 that can hold video, audio, subtitles and metadata. H.264 video with AAC audio is the most common combination.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting AVI to MP4
points: The video is re-encoded as H.264, and the audio as AAC at 96 kbps.
Re-encoding is lossy, so the MP4 is at best as good as the AVI.
Frames are scaled down when the longer side passes 1920 px, and the frame rate is capped at 30 fps.
Interlaced video is deinterlaced.
Converting several AVI files gives one MP4 for each, with no ZIP.

seo.title: Convert MP4 to MOV Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert MP4 to MOV in your browser by copying the streams into a MOV container, with no re-encoding. Free, with no sign-up, and no upload.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert MP4 to MOV

tool.subtitle: Move an MP4 video into a MOV file without re-encoding, right in your browser.

faqs.question: How do I convert MP4 to MOV?
faqs.answer: Choose the MP4 above and start the conversion. FFmpeg copies the video and audio streams into a MOV container, and you download the MOV.

faqs.question: Does converting MP4 to MOV lose quality?
faqs.answer: No. The streams are copied, not re-encoded, so the picture and sound are the same as in the MP4. Only the container around them changes.

faqs.question: Why is the conversion so quick?
faqs.answer: Nothing is re-encoded: the streams are copied into the new container. A long file still takes as long as your device needs.

faqs.question: Does the MOV keep the MP4's size and frame rate?
faqs.answer: Yes. The video isn't scaled or re-timed, because the streams are copied as they are.

faqs.question: Will subtitles and chapters carry over?
faqs.answer: The page can't promise it. It passes no option for them, so FFmpeg's defaults decide what the MOV keeps. Check the result in your player or editor.

fromFormat.name: MP4
fromFormat.description: A container format defined in ISO/IEC 14496-14 that can hold video, audio, subtitles and metadata. H.264 video with AAC audio is the most common combination.

toFormat.name: MOV
toFormat.description: The container format of Apple's QuickTime, which also served as the basis for the MPEG-4 file format. It stores video, audio, text and timecode tracks.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting MP4 to MOV
points: The streams are copied into a MOV container, not re-encoded.
Picture and sound stay as they were in the MP4.
Several MP4 files give one MOV for each, with no ZIP.
Your MP4 stays unchanged: you download a new MOV.
